# IndesignLive

> > IndesignLive is Australia's leading platform for interior design and architecture news, professional development, and industry resources serving architects and designers across the Asia-Pacific region.

IndesignLive provides daily design news, project showcases, professional development through CPD Live courses, and curated product collections for architecture and interior design professionals. The platform serves as a central hub for industry insights, designer profiles, and design inspiration across commercial, hospitality, and residential sectors.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design
- Architecture
- Australian Design
- Asia-Pacific
- CPD Professional Development
- Design Awards
- Design Projects
- Furniture & Products
- Design News

- CPD Live
- Design Industry

- Design Trends

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://www.indesignlive.com): Daily design news, projects, and resources for architecture professionals
- [Projects](https://www.indesignlive.com/projects): Showcase of commercial, retail and hospitality design projects across Asia-Pacific
- [News](https://www.indesignlive.com/news): Latest design industry news, events, awards and studio appointments across Australia
- [Products](https://www.indesignlive.com/products): Product directory for workplace furniture, hospitality and architectural design products
- [Collection](https://www.indesignlive.com/collection): Product collection hub for design professionals to browse furniture, finishes and brands

## Professional Development & Learning

- [CPD Live](https://www.indesignlive.com/cpdlive): Professional development platform offering free CPD-accredited courses and live sessions
- [Podcast - Stories](https://www.indesignlive.com/podcast): Stories Indesign podcast featuring interviews with architects and designers
- [Indesign TV](https://www.indesignlive.com/tv): Video archives including interviews, product demos and design project showcases
- [Newsletter](https://www.indesignlive.com/newsletter): Email newsletter signup for design news, magazine and CPD Live updates

## Industry Insights & Inspiration

- [Ideas](https://www.indesignlive.com/ideas): Think pieces and design inspiration exploring contemporary trends and installations
- [People](https://www.indesignlive.com/people): Profiles and interviews with architects and designers shaping the design industry
- [Edits](https://www.indesignlive.com/edit): Curated design collections and product features from Salone del Mobile and beyond

## Magazine & Subscriptions

- [Subscribe](https://www.indesignlive.com/subscribe): Subscription page for INDESIGN magazine, CPD Live courses and Stories podcast

## Featured Projects

- [Soori Penang - SCDA Architects & Soo K. Chan](https://www.indesignlive.com/projects/soori-penang-soo-k-chan): SCDA Architects' heritage shophouse restoration and boutique hotel in Penang
- [One Two Five Hub - Perth](https://www.indesignlive.com/projects/one-two-five-hub-perth): Hub Australia and Hassell's hybrid workplace design in Perth featuring flexible coworking
- [Willowdale Sports Precinct - Sam Crawford Architects](https://www.indesignlive.com/projects/willowdale-sports-precinct-sam-crawford): Sports pavilion design inspired by indigenous heritage and ancient clay ovens
